body.p: An orphan boy who lived with an old woman always tried to obtain gulls; and because he only caught gulls, they had just a little to eat; but one day, when that poor boy went to catch gulls, he caught a whale instead. He made it fast with some whalebone which he attached to its tail. Then he went home to tell of his good fortune. An old man derided him, saying, "What, is this mite of a boy making a man of himself?"

The old woman with whom he lived said, "Go and tell those outside." Now the old woman gave him a knife; and because the neighbors wished to partake of the whale-meat, they gave the old woman some nice dressed skins.
